Read the full RjPDs5M3-Lg transcript 0–52s and its single catalogue chapter. At 0–11 accessibility/voice description is introduced; at 24–39 a Semantics child FlutterLogo and the label 'this is the Flutter logo' are demonstrated, supporting f1/f2's meaning and label construction (illustrative logo, not an actionable control). However 10.56–19.68 explicitly says that to work with semantics 'you will need' to add showSemanticsDebugger true to MaterialApp. BLOCKING: this presents a debugging overlay as a prerequisite for using Semantics. The proposed end at 39 also truncates the displayed-description sentence extending to 41.76. Starting after the false claim loses the debugger setup on which the shown overlay result relies, so it is not a clean standalone repair of this proposed tutorial. Replace with a correct independent labeling demonstration or use another source; do not approve the erroneous setup claim. Narrated widget composition and visible overlay support visual value, but cannot compensate for technical error.
